data.summary: This week Ethan Qiu made 31 GitHub contributions across three public repositories: UTMIST/Misty, qiuethan/Portfolio, and qiuethan/now. He recorded 23 contributions to UTMIST/Misty, 5 to qiuethan/Portfolio, and 3 to qiuethan/now, and opened pull requests in all three repositories, including UTMIST/Misty#263, #265, #267, and #269. He also reviewed six pull requests in UTMIST/Misty: #230, #259, #261, #262, #264, and #268.
